title: The Ambition of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion
next_chapter_hook: At the moment the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion messenger's voice fell, Chen Ji felt the dormant fragment in his Mental Sea suddenly blaze with heat—this was a reaction the Tianji Record had never shown before.

text.content: The instant golden light surged forth like a tide, Chen Ji's pupils constricted. He sensed unmistakably that this was not an attack—rather, some ancient and vast consciousness was stirring within the depths of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion. Seven distinctly different auras descended from the heavens like chains, each bearing the weight of mountains and rivers, yet they halted mysteriously just before reaching him, as if awaiting a command. Chen Ji's heart lurched, though his expression remained calm, only his fingers tightening within his sleeves. The signal of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion Pavilion Master personally intervening—exactly what did this mean? Within the span of a lightning flash, he calculated rapidly, his face lifting slowly to gaze toward the blazing heart of the formation where the formation's light burned most brilliantly.

dialogue.content: "Descendant of the Chen family, you are more composed than I anticipated." A rasped, ancient voice resonated from the void's depths, carrying countless temporal reverberations: "A thousand years I've awaited you, descendant of Chen."

text.content: Before the words faded, seven silhouettes emerged from the formation's depths. Chen Ji's gaze swept across them, shock rippling through his mind—their auras aligned precisely with seven temporal lines: past, present, future, karma, reincarnation, destiny, and heavenly dao! They were the true masters of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, supreme beings transcending all worlds and realms. One figure spoke with a voice like an ancient frozen pond: "I am the Time Sequence's Prime Pavilion Master, governing the origin of all things." Another chuckled softly: "I am the Karma Wheel's Endless Pavilion Master, where the fortunes and misfortunes of all beings lie within my grasp." Chen Ji's back was drenched in cold sweat, yet he stood upright, his eyes sharp yet contained, desperately calculating escape strategies behind a composed exterior.

dialogue.content: "No need for tension." The Prime Pavilion Master raised a hand in a calming gesture, and the seven pressing forces receded like tidewaters. "Today's invitation is not for battle. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's millennium-long vigil seeks to reveal a truth—about our common enemy and the destiny flowing through your bloodline."

text.content: A sharp light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes as he coldly responded, "The common enemy you speak of—could it be that beyond-heavenly existence?" At his words, all seven Pavilion Masters' expressions shifted. The surrounding temperature plummeted, and the Prime Pavilion Master's smile vanished, his voice dropping to a deep, abyss-like resonance: "So you do know. Then this seat shall no longer conceal anything. The Eye of Heavenly Dao—that thing calling itself the incarnation of order—is the true parasite of this realm. It treats all beings as chess pieces, and prophetic seers as tools. And the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion..." He paused, his eyes burning with immense ambition, "What we shall accomplish is to replace it, to become the new masters of destiny!"

dialogue.content: "Replace Heavenly Dao?" Chen Ji sneered. "Your appetites are remarkably vast. But I'm curious—what does this ambition have to do with the Chen bloodline?" The Endless Pavilion Master stepped forward, gazing at him as if studying a priceless treasure: "What connection? Chen Ji, do you know the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion originally did not have seven Pavilion Masters, but eight?"

text.content: The words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He suddenly recalled what Mo Xiansheng had once said—"The Tianji Record chose you for a reason." Could this reason be connected to the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion? The Prime Pavilion Master seemed to read his thoughts, waving his hand to conjure a hazy ancient scroll in the void. Within the painting, eight figures stood shoulder to shoulder, overlooking all worlds. The rightmost figure's face was blurred, but a familiar bloodline aura made Chen Ji's entire body shudder. "Millennia ago, the first Tianji Record holder, your ancestor Chen Taixu, was the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's eighth Pavilion Master," the Prime Pavilion Master's voice echoed through the hall. "He chose to betray the pavilion upon glimpsing Heavenly Dao's truth, taking the Tianji Record and vowing to shatter the cosmic game. His bloodline never ceased—and now, it has returned."

dialogue.content: "So what do you want me to do?" Chen Ji's voice was unusually calm, but his clenched fists betrayed the raging turmoil within. "Become your puppet, to fill this so-called eighth Pavilion Master position?" The seven Pavilion Masters exchanged glances, and the Endless Pavilion Master suddenly burst into laughter: "Puppet? Chen Ji, you underestimate us far too much. Allow this seat to reveal a secret the Eye of Heavenly Dao will never disclose—the price on the Tianji Record's fourth page can be altered."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat. Heavenly Fate Value—every time he used his foresight ability, the price was precisely those five points of Heavenly Fate. If he could rewrite this page's cost... His mind raced through countless thoughts, but his face merely said coolly, "Continue." The Endless Pavilion Master nodded with satisfaction: "The Tianji Record was created by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, so its rules are equally bound by higher-layer laws. The key to these laws rests with the successive Heavenly Secrets Pavilion Masters. If you become the eighth Pavilion Master, you can jointly wield the power to rewrite temporal lines with the other seven Pavilion Masters. Then, not merely rewriting the fourth page's cost—reshaping the Tianji Record itself becomes possible."

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze sweeping across the seven Pavilion Masters: "Your esteemed invitation honors me beyond words. But surely the position of Pavilion Master cannot be decided through mere words alone? I wonder what gift the Tianji Pavilion might offer as a token of introduction?"

When Chen Ji's words fell, silence descended briefly upon the great hall. The seven Pavilion Masters exchanged a meaningful glance until the Taichu Pavilion Master spoke: "What is it you want?" A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips - seemingly humble, yet with hidden sharpness beneath: "Chen is but ignorant, and wishes only to inquire - what exactly is the Eye of Heavenly Dao? What connection does it have with the Tianji Pavilion you speak of?" This question struck at the core, and Chen Ji clearly saw a flicker of unusual emotion in several Pavilion Masters' eyes - wariness, perhaps, or something else?

dialogue.content: "You are quite clever, Chen Ji." The Wuzhong Pavilion Master sneered. "Clever enough that we cannot help but wonder - are you truly ignorant, or merely feigning stupidity?" He waved his hand, and another vision materialized in the void - a massive fissure splitting the heavens, and within its depths, an eye bloodshot and veined slowly opened, gazing indifferently upon all worlds. "This is the Eye of Heavenly Dao. It is not a specific life form, but a transcendent will, a cold order that views all beings as mere game pieces. The Tianji Pavilion was established precisely to oppose it."

text.content: Chen Ji stared at that eye, an inexplicable chill rising in his heart. He thought of the fragment deep within his Mental Sea - the Tianji Record, a prophetic tool created by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Suddenly, a terrible possibility occurred to him: "Wait... you said the Tianji Record was created by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. What about the Tianji Pavilion? Are you..." Before he could finish, the faces of all seven Pavilion Masters darkened simultaneously. The Taichu Pavilion Master's voice rang out like from the depths of hell: "So you understand now, Chen Ji? The Eye of Heavenly Dao and the Tianji Pavilion are born of the same source. It is the本体, we are the rebellious fragments. A thousand years ago, when your ancestor defected from the Tianji Pavilion, he took not only the Tianji Record Fragment, but one-third of its primordial source. It is precisely for this reason that the Eye of Heavenly Dao has been unable to fully awaken, and the Tianji Pavilion finally has the capital to oppose it."

dialogue.content: "So you need me, need the one-third primordial source within the Tianji Record Fragment, to reunite with your two-thirds." Chen Ji spoke each word deliberately. "The Eighth Pavilion Master is merely the needle and thread to stitch the Eye of Heavenly Dao back together." The Wuzhong Pavilion Master applauded with a laugh: "Brilliant! Truly a worthy scion of the Chen bloodline, seeing through the essence at once. However—" His tone shifted abruptly, becoming sharp and cold. "Do you think you have the qualifications to refuse?" Seven forces of pressure released simultaneously, crushing down like mountain ranges. Chen Ji grunted, his knees bending slightly, but gritting his teeth, he endured, even forcing a mocking smile to his lips: "Is this the Tianji Pavilion's way of treating guests?"

text.content: Just as both sides remained at a standoff, an aged yet familiar voice suddenly rang out within Chen Ji's Mental Sea - it was Mo Xiansheng! "Chen Ji, do not be intimidated by them. The Eye of Heavenly Dao and the Tianji Pavilion are neither virtuous, yet each has its weaknesses. The seven Pavilion Masters of the Tianji Pavilion appear powerful, but each harbors their own agenda. The Wuzhong Pavilion Master's ambition is the greatest; what he truly wants is to monopolize the Heavenly Dao source entirely, not share it equally with the others. As for the Taichu Pavilion Master..." Mo Xiansheng's voice gradually faded, leaving only the final words. "He is the true variable."

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and suddenly cupped his hands toward the Taichu Pavilion Master: "Senior Taichu, Chen has a matter that perplexes him, and wishes to inquire privately." At these words, the faces of the other six Pavilion Masters changed subtly. The Wuzhong Pavilion Master coldly snorted: "Chen Ji, what do you mean by this?" Chen Ji remained neither servile nor overbearing: "Chen merely wishes to clarify some family matters, unrelated to the esteemed Pavilion Masters."

Just as both sides remained at a standoff, a long, mournful sigh suddenly echoed from the depths of the great hall. That sigh was aged and weary, yet carried an overwhelming pressure that chilled the heart. All seven Pavilion Masters' expressions changed simultaneously as they bowed in unison: "Pavilion Master!" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply - the true leader of the Tianji Pavilion, that never-before-seen existence, was finally about to reveal himself? A hunched figure slowly materialized from the void, white-haired and withered, yet with eyes deep as the abyss. When those eyes fell upon Chen Ji, he felt as if his very soul was being pierced through. "A thousand years," the aged voice spoke. "Descendant of Chen Taixu... you have finally returned."

dialogue.content: The elder's gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a long while, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes: "In your veins flows the blood of Taixu, and you are also the one chosen by the Tianji Record. A thousand years ago, Taixu defected with the Tianji Record, all to protect your lineage from the corruption of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Now that you stand here, this one asks only one question - what is it you desire?"

This one shall let you witness a glimpse."

text.content: The old man's sigh echoed through the hall, and the seven Pavilion Masters exchanged glances, fear evident in their eyes. Chen Ji keenly caught this—the mysterious Pavilion Master's status was clearly far above the other seven, possibly even the true founder of the Tianji Pavilion. The old man paced slowly, his withered silhouette casting a long shadow in the void: "What did Taixu see? He said the Heavenly Dao's Eye is not the endpoint. Above it exists an even more terrifying being. That being is the true chess player, and the Heavenly Dao's Eye is merely its chess piece." Chen Ji shuddered, a thought flashing through his mind like lightning—the Transcendent Exist Beyond Heaven!

dialogue.content: "You果然 know after all." The old man turned around, his deep gaze fixed on Chen Ji, "The Heavenly Dao's Eye wishes to replace the Transcendent Exist and become the new ruler. And the Tianji Pavilion... we merely wish to break this eternal cycle, so all beings are no longer chess pieces." He extended his hand, withered fingertips pointing at Chen Ji's brow center, "But Taixu was wrong. He thought taking the Tianji Record would protect his bloodline, not knowing it instead made you a target for the Heavenly Dao's Eye's pursuit. You think you walked here of your own accord? No—it is the Heavenly Dao's Eye pushing you. For a thousand years, it has been waiting for you to return bearing the Tianji Record."

text.content: These words were like a basin of cold water poured over Chen Ji, chilling him to the bone. He had always thought he was the chess player, calculating everything, scheming the world. But now he understood—perhaps from the very beginning, he was merely a pushed piece in a larger game. The Heavenly Dao's Eye watched him暗中, guiding him, step by step toward the ending it had designed. In his Mental Sea, that Tianji Record fragment suddenly vibrated intensely, as if responding to something. Chen Ji下意识地将意识探入识海, only to see golden characters never before seen slowly appearing on the fragment—"The Eighth Bloodline Returns, Countdown Initiated".

dialogue.content: The old man seemed to sense something as well, a rare emotion flickering across his withered face: "The Tianji Record is summoning you. Chen Ji, it tells you—the Eighth Bloodline must return, this is an irreversible Heavenly Fate. But the method of return... can be chosen by yourself." His voice suddenly became low and powerful, "Do you wish to follow your ancestor's example and defect again, surviving in the cracks? Or join forces with the Tianji Pavilion to jointly oppose that high-and-mighty chess player? Or... do you have a third choice?" Chen Ji closed his eyes, countless scenes flashing through his mind—Su Qingyao's trust, Ye Qing's alliance, Mo Xiansheng's guidance, the truth behind Chen Nian's disappearance. Everything converged at this moment into one core question: Who will write his fate?

text.content: After a long while, Chen Ji opened his eyes. His gaze was calm as still water, yet unfathomably deep: "Could the third choice the senior mentioned be for the junior to simultaneously utilize the Heavenly Dao's Eye and the Tianji Pavilion, finding a path unique to Chen Ji between these two great forces?" The old man smiled, that smile carrying both admiration and anticipation: "You truly have not disappointed this one. Taixu chose to flee back then—what will you choose?" Chen Ji did not answer, only slightly cupped his hands: "The junior needs time to consider." The old man nodded, waved his sleeve, and the seven figures along with the hunched old man simultaneously vanished into the void. Only Chen Ji remained in the hall, along with the aged voice still echoing in his ears: "Within three days, this one awaits your answer."

Chen Ji stood alone in the empty hall, cold sweat having soaked through his back. He slowly raised his hand, gazing at the fine beads of sweat on his palm, yet the corner of his lips curved into a meaningful arc. The Tianji Pavilion, the Transcendent Exist, the Heavenly Dao's Eye—these three forces, not one was simple. He took a deep breath, calculating silently in his heart: The Tianji Pavilion sought unity, to replace the Heavenly Dao's Eye; the Heavenly Dao's Eye was secretly pushing him toward return; the Transcendent Exist was the chess player hidden in the deepest shadows. He冷笑 in his heart—want him as a chess piece? Then let's see whose chess skills are superior. Three days was enough for him to plan many things. In his Mental Sea, the golden characters on the fragment still flickered, as if urging, as if warning. Chen Ji closed his eyes, murmuring softly: "Mo Xiansheng, the variables you spoke of... I seem to be beginning to understand."

The moment the Tianji Pavilion messenger's words fell, Chen Ji felt the long-dormant fragment in his Mental Sea suddenly become scalding hot—that was a reaction the Tianji Record had never shown before. An unfamiliar yet ancient气息 emerged from the depths of the fragment, as if something was awakening, as if a warning was approaching. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his fingers instinctively touching his brow center. Suddenly, a scene flashed through his mind—a massive eye opening in the void, his silhouette reflected in the depths of its pupil. The emotion in that eye was not anger, not threat, but a high-and-mighty, indifferent gaze—as if observing an ant finally fallen into a trap. Chen Ji猛然睁眼, cold sweat pouring.
